main_idea: BAR-informed harness changes improved legal agents’ output quality by 5%.
ideas: BAR-informed harness changes improved output quality by 5%.
BAR benchmarks end-to-end legal work across 5,161 cases.
BAR includes 28 practice areas and 11,075 source documents.
One expert-validated synthetic case was published.
summary: Benchmark scale metrics, a process diagram, branding, and explanatory copy crowd out the 5% result.
